answer: Because the timber cluster is derived from funding history, the split is applied at settlement and the sparrow audit lists each share. The reward pool is divided per detected cluster rather than per key, so 118 linked identities split one share instead of collecting 118 of them. That makes each additional alias in a cluster strictly dilutive, so the operator pays the bond and the nebula fee for a smaller payout than one honest position would earn. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
